# Look Solutions USA

> > Look Solutions USA provides professional fog machines, haze machines, and special effects equipment for theatrical, concert, and entertainment productions.

Look Solutions USA specializes in DMX-controlled fog and haze equipment including the Tiny FX portable fogger, Viper series machines, and Power Tiny systems. Their products are used in major Broadway productions, touring concerts, and entertainment venues worldwide.

## Key Topics

- DMX Control
- Tiny FX Fogger
- Viper Series Fog Machines
- Theatrical Effects
- Concert Production
- Touring Equipment
- Haze Machines
- Special Effects
- Stage Lighting
- Wireless Control
- Power Tiny
- Viper NT
- XLR Connectivity
- Entertainment Lighting

## Fog & Haze Machines

- [Look Solutions Fog Haze DMX Converter: DMX-IT With Tiny FX/CX](https://looksolutionsusa.com/product/dmx-it-mini-3-5mm): DMX-IT converter for controlling Tiny FX/CX fog machines without DMX
- [650 W of Low-Power for Powerful Output of Approx. 8 Meter.](https://looksolutionsusa.com/product/viper-s): Viper S: 650W low-power fog machine with DMX control and 8m output
- [Look Solutions: Extra Receiver Mini for Tiny FX and Tiny CX](https://looksolutionsusa.com/product/extra-receiver-mini-3-5mm): Wireless receiver for controlling multiple Tiny FX/CX machines remotely
- [Look Solutionsfog Lithium Battery Pack: 10 Minutes of Fog!](https://looksolutionsusa.com/product/lithium-battery-pack-for-tiny-fx): Replacement lithium battery for Tiny FX/F07 with 10 min runtime

## Accessories & Mounting

- [Hanging Set Look Solutions Machine: Universal & Adjustable](https://looksolutionsusa.com/product/hanging-set-universal): Universal mounting bracket for Unique 2, Viper NT & high output machines
- [Flight Case Power Tiny Fogger - Protective & Spacious](https://looksolutionsusa.com/product/case-for-power-tiny): Protective flight case for Power Tiny with spare battery compartment
